purpose: Teach: 同名/気配り/調査官/貸借/割当/局員/上半期/釈明

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、同名の競合との競争を勝ち抜かれたぞ
lines.en: When you were founding the company, you outmaneuvered that rival with the same name.
lines.style: Gentle, measured recollection. Warm weight behind each phrase. The tone of someone honoring a memory aloud. Steady eye contact, small nod of respect embedded in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員一人一人への気配りを欠かさなかった
lines.en: Yes. He never let his attention to each person on staff slip for a moment.
lines.style: Quiet certainty. Speaking from lived example, not rote learning. Each word placed with care. A son confirming what he watched his father do, over and over.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、税務調査官の指摘にも誠実に応じられたぞ
lines.en: And when the tax investigator came, he answered every question with complete honesty.
lines.style: Soft, nostalgic. The voice of someone moved by integrity he witnessed. Slight pause before 'he answered,' like the weight of that choice still matters. Trailing warmth.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは工場の貸借契約を慎重に結ばれた
lines.en: Yes. He was careful and deliberate with every factory lease he signed.
lines.style: Reflective, steady. Speaking as if he's seeing it happen again. Not reciting—understanding. Grounded tone, no performance. The gravity of small careful choices.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、業務の割当を公平に決められたぞ
lines.en: And when it came to assigning work, he made sure it was always fair.
lines.style: Wistful, almost gentle. The voice of someone grateful for a lesson learned by watching. Slight tender quality—this fairness mattered. Small breath before the phrase.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは郵便局員さんにもお礼を欠かされなかった
lines.en: Yes. And he never forgot to thank the postal workers and everyone else who helped.
lines.style: Quiet, sincere. The small details matter in his voice—he's noticing the care his father showed. Warm without sentimentality. Grounded, like this is just how things were done.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、上半期決算で社員に感謝の言葉を述べられたぞ
lines.en: At the end of the first half, he told the staff how grateful he was for them.
lines.style: Soft, tender recollection. The voice of someone who remembers being in that room. Slight catch of emotion held steady. Warmth that doesn't spill—controlled, deep.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは不祥事の釈明会見で誠実に対応された
lines.en: Yes. And when there was a scandal, he held a press conference and answered for it honestly.
lines.style: Calm, grounded finality. The voice of someone who understands that integrity doesn't waver when it matters most. No drama—just the weight of doing the right thing. Slight settling quality at the end.
